verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://developers.notion.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a curated index of Markdown doc links, and the docs are served as agent-readable .md pages (webhooks, Agent APIs, MCP guides). A machine-readable OpenAPI spec is also published at /openapi.json. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or bundled full-context export, and no independent or community report of agents actually consuming these docs.
